title: Opening Keynote - Ship 26 NYC
description:
Over half of all deployments on Vercel now come from coding agents, and increasingly, those agents are shipping agents of their own. Recorded live at Vercel Ship 2026 in New York City on June 30, this keynote introduces the agentic infrastructure built for that shift: one platform where humans and agents build, deploy, and run websites, apps, and agents together.
 
Featuring Guillermo Rauch (Founder & CEO), Malte Ubl (CTO), Tom Occhino (CPO), Shar Dara (Product, Agent Framework), and Jeanne DeWitt Grosser (COO).
 
CHAPTERS
0:00 The agentic web
8:44 Fluid Compute 2.0, Docker, and Vercel Services
17:12 The Agent Stack: AI SDK 7, AI Gateway, Workflow SDK, Sandbox, Connect, and Chat SDK
29:41 Introducing eve + live demo
38:05 Vercel Agent
41:16 100+ agents in production and Vercel for Enterprise Apps and Agents
53:54 Wrap-up
